title: arch_guard.yaml
description: Configuration for arch_guard, the architecture checker for Dart and Flutter. See https://creatorpiyush.github.io/arch_guard/configuration.html

packages.description: Packages (`dio`) or core libraries (`dart:io`). Globs allowed (`firebase_*`).

ignore.description: Extra files to leave out of the scan. Generated files such as `*.g.dart` and `*.freezed.dart` are always skipped.

layers.description: Layer name → `patterns` (globs), `allowed_imports` (layer names) and optional `forbidden_packages`. With a preset, overrides or adds layers. A file belongs to the first layer whose patterns match.

patterns.description: Globs matched against the file path relative to the project root, e.g. `lib/**/domain/**`.

allowed_imports.description: Layers files in this layer may import. A layer may always import itself.

forbidden_packages.description: Packages or core libraries files in this layer may not import.

max_scc_size.description: Fail when a circular-dependency group has more files than this, even with `--no-fail-on-cycle`.

fail_on_layer_violation.description: Whether layer violations make the run exit with `1`.

forbidden_packages.description: Packages (`dio`) or core libraries (`dart:io`) no scanned file may import. Globs allowed (`firebase_*`).

metrics.description: Coupling limits and the hotspot list.

max_fan_out.description: Fail when a file imports more project files than this.

max_fan_in.description: Fail when more project files than this import one file.

hotspots.description: How many most-coupled files reports list (0 = none).

workspace_rules.description: In a workspace: member selector (glob on a member's path or name) → `allowed:` members it may import.

allowed.description: Members (globs on path or name) this member may import. `[]` allows none.

unused_files.description: Report scanned files that no entry point reaches. `true` turns it on with the defaults.

entry_points.description: Extra entry-point globs, added to the defaults (`lib/main.dart`, `bin/`, `test/`, ...).

fail.description: Whether unused files make the run fail (exit code 1).
